The most recent evidence points to Kubernetes 1.37 as the latest minor release, but the sources don't agree on dates, so treat this as likely rather than confirmed.

- **Kubernetes 1.37:** The official release page lists 1.37.0 (Released on 2026-08-26) as the latest patch, with the next patch, 1.37.1, targeted for 2026-09-15. A Vietnamese-language copy of the same page reports the same release date (1.37.0 (Released on 2026-08-26)).
- **Older data:** The versionlog.com page is out of date. It shows 1.36.2 Released 11 Jun 2026 as the latest stable release, with 1.37.0-alpha.3 as the latest pre-release. Its date stamps suggest it was cached around July 2026.
- **Supported 1.36 line:** The 1.36 docs list 1.36.2 (Released on 2026-06-09) as the latest 1.36 patch, with end of life on 2027-06-28.

Based on this, the latest Kubernetes release as of October 2026 appears to be v1.37.0, released August 26, 2026. I couldn't check for patch releases after that, so 1.37.x may have newer patches than what I found. Checking kubernetes.io/releases directly would confirm this.

content.text:
The latest Kubernetes minor release appears to be **v1.37 ("Garhwal")**. Its first release, 1.37.0, came out on 2026-08-26.

- The official release page also lists 1.37.1 as targeted for 2026-09-15. I couldn't confirm whether it shipped or whether there are later 1.37.x patches. The official releases page will show the current patch.
- The previous minor, 1.36, was last listed at 1.36.2 (2026-06-09). It's supported until 2027-06-28.

Sources:
- [Kubernetes 1.37: Garhwal](https://kubernetes.io/releases/1.37/)
- [Kubernetes 1.37 (Vietnamese copy)](https://kubernetes.io/vi/releases/1.37/)
- [Kubernetes 1.36 release page](https://v1-36.docs.kubernetes.io/it/releases/1.36/)
- [versionlog.com Kubernetes](https://versionlog.com/kubernetes/) (outdated)
